answer_1.quote: The capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to rapidly generate high-quality text at scale makes them valuable sources of training data.
answer_1.outputs: The paper discusses generated text from LLMs used in knowledge distillation, including paraphrased and watermark-neutralized outputs.

answer_2.quote: For watermark detection, we prompted the distilled student models to generate texts using C4 dataset. The generated tokens were grouped into fixed-size samples, with p-values calculated for each group and the median reported.
